corollary_6_4.label: cor:algebraic-specialization
corollary_6_4.role: Its proof invokes OpenAICMHodge2026 Theorem 1.1 to algebraize kappa, then specializes and pulls back a rational cycle.

theorem_dependency.logical_dependency_direction: CM Hodge thm:cm + Milne CM transport cor:cm-transport => specialization application. Milne cor:algebraic-specialization itself depends on CM Hodge thm:cm. Hence cor:algebraic-specialization cannot be an independent premise for thm:cm. The CM Hodge manuscript explicitly places both citations in its consequences remark and disclaims use in its main theorem. This is a source-level dependency graph, not a proof of either theorem.
theorem_dependency.chronological_note: The October 6 CM Hodge edition cites the October 7 Milne edition within the pinned October 8 source snapshot. This is a version-reference fact, not a demonstrated inconsistency.
theorem_dependency.scope_guard: A bibliography cross-reference cycle is not necessarily a circular proof; any argument promoting Milne corollary 6.4 as independent support for CM Hodge thm:cm would be circular.
